## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the boundary it affects.

## Verification

- [ ] Rust formatting, Clippy, and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Web lint, unit tests, and build pass when frontend code changes.
- [ ] Security defaults and failure behavior have regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation reflects CLI, protocol, or security-boundary changes.
- [ ] No credentials, bootstrap URLs, host keys, or private logs are included.
- [ ] Dependency changes update lockfiles and explain license/advisory impact.

## Risk and rollback

State the affected platforms, compatibility risks, and how to revert safely.
